name: UNSW Interest-Free Student Loan
summary: Interest-free repayable loan for enrolled UNSW students who have completed at least one term.
key: UNSW student loans are typically offered up to a value of $1,500, with up to $4,000 in exceptional circumstances.
who: Completed at least one semester or term
Good academic standing and no outstanding debts to UNSW
Able to repay within the required timeframe
how: Book an appointment with a Student Support Advisor
Provide documentary evidence for loans over $200
catches: Loans up to $500 repaid within six months; up to $1,500 within twelve months
You can't graduate until the loan is repaid

evidence.quote: UNSW student loans are typically offered up to a value of $1,500.
